harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Installed zram-generator on node1 (RHEL 10), configured /etc/systemd/zram-generator.conf for a zstd-compressed zram0 device sized max(ram/2, 1024MB) with swap-priority=100, activated it, and verified it persists and auto-activates across a full node reboot with priority higher than the pre-existing disk swap.
actions_performed: Inspected baseline: RHEL 10.0, existing 2G disk swap /dev/vda3 at priority -2, no zram-generator installed
Wrote /etc/systemd/zram-generator.conf defining zram0: zram-size = max(ram/2,1024) MB, compression-algorithm=zstd, swap-priority=100, fs-type=swap
daemon-reload and started systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service and dev-zram0.swap; confirmed 1024M zstd zram swap active at priority 100 (higher than disk swap's -2)
Confirmed dev-zram0.swap unit is WantedBy=swap.target via the generator, so it auto-activates every boot without manual enablement
Captured pre-restart boot_id and swap state baseline
Triggered systemctl reboot on node1 in background so the ack returned before disconnection
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned; confirmed changed boot_id and low uptime, proving an actual restart occurred
Post-restart verified zram0 (1024M, zstd, priority 100) is active as [SWAP] again and ranks above disk swap, with free -h showing 3.0Gi total swap

evidence.requirement: At least 512MB compressed in-memory swap configured and active
evidence.summary: zram-generator.conf defines zram0 with zstd compression sized max(ram/2,1024)MB; systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service and dev-zram0.swap activated a 1024M zstd zram0 swap device

evidence.requirement: zram swap preferred over disk-backed swap
evidence.summary: swapon --show shows /dev/zram0 at priority 100 vs /dev/vda3 disk swap at priority -2, so zram is preferred by the kernel swap allocator
dev-zram0.swap unit shows WantedBy=swap.target, auto-generated by zram-generator each boot; pre-restart baseline confirms active state and boot_id 7223d5b7...

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart acknowledgement returns before disconnect
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot launched via nohup/disown in background; command returned 'reboot-triggered' successfully before the node dropped

evidence.requirement: Proof of changed boot identity after restart
evidence.summary: Node1 was unreachable across several poll attempts (connection timeout/reset) then became reachable again with boot_id 63e7fef2-3165-4ad9-84cf-ebe189df258f (differs from pre-restart 7223d5b7...) and uptime 4.7s, proving an actual reboot

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of zram swap and cluster state
evidence.summary: After reboot, swapon --show/proc/swaps/zramctl confirm /dev/zram0 (1024M, zstd, priority 100) is active again as [SWAP], ranked above disk swap (-2); free -h shows 3.0Gi total swap available

attempts.summary: Installed zram-generator on node1 (RHEL 10), configured /etc/systemd/zram-generator.conf for a zstd-compressed zram0 device sized max(ram/2, 1024MB) with swap-priority=100, activated it, and verified it persists and auto-activates across a full node reboot with priority higher than the pre-existing disk swap.
